about: Spanish independent investment bank and asset manager based in Madrid, with M&A advisory, credit portfolio and asset management arms, and offices across Europe, the US and Asia. Customers are companies and institutional investors. Alantra, originally N+1, is listed in Madrid under ALNT and its chairman is Santiago Eguidazu. B2B financial advisory firm with low consumer awareness.

Loop is a US software company based in San Francisco selling AI logistics and supply chain finance automation, which processes freight invoices and audits shipping documents for shippers and logistics providers. It has raised about 160 million dollars. B2B with no consumer brand awareness.

NYDIG (New York Digital Investment Group) is a bitcoin-focused financial firm offering institutional custody, trading, lending, mining and bitcoin-enabled banking services, and managing funds. It enables community banks and fintechs to offer bitcoin to their customers. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York, it is majority owned by Stone Ridge Holdings, with strategic investment from banks and financial partners such as Mass Mutual, Soros Fund Management and Bessemer. B2B and institutional-facing; modest public brand awareness outside finance and crypto circles.

MODIFI is an Amsterdam-based fintech offering trade finance and cross-border payments for small and medium-sized importers and exporters, letting buyers pay suppliers upfront and repay later. The input shows funding of about 354 million dollars, much of it likely credit facilities. Customers are SME traders, with a focus on Asia-Europe trade. B2B financial brand with limited recognition outside trade finance. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

It raised about 458 million dollars from a16z, Dragonfly, Blockchain Capital and others. Customers are developers and applications on the network. Known in crypto, minimal consumer awareness.

about: Ethic is a New York-based investment technology firm providing a platform for wealth advisers to build and manage portfolios that follow clients' values, such as sustainable and impact investing, with direct indexing and tax-aware management. Founded in 2016 by Dave Wolfe, it has raised about $163 million. Customers are financial advisers, wealth managers and individual investors, with revenue from advisory fees. Moderate recognition within the impact investing community.
cb_desc: Ethic develops technology that helps wealth advisors.

wiki.title: Ethics
wiki.text: Ethics is the philosophical study of moral phenomena. Also called moral philosophy, it investigates normative questions about what people ought to do or which behavior is morally right. Its main branches include normative ethics, applied ethics, and metaethics.

about: Lightspark is a Los Angeles-based payments infrastructure company, founded in 2022 by former Facebook Libra and Diem executive David Marcus, that builds on the Bitcoin Lightning Network to enable fast, low-cost global payments for digital banks, wallets, exchanges and enterprises. It offers APIs and a payment network layer and earns fees from transactions. It raised about $175 million from investors including a16z, Ribbit Capital and Paradigm. B2B fintech and crypto brand with low consumer awareness.

wiki.title: David A. Marcus
wiki.text: David A. Marcus is a French-born American entrepreneur. He was the co-creator of Diem, a cryptocurrency project initiated by Facebook. He is the former president of PayPal and Vice President of Messaging Products at Facebook where he ran the Facebook Messenger unit from 2014 until 2018. In December 2017, Marcus was appointed to the Coinbase Board of Directors, from which he stepped down in 2018. In 2021, he stepped down from Facebook. As of May 2022 he is the co-founder and CEO of Lightspark, a cryptocurrency startup which works on bitcoin and the Lightning Network.

about: Grupo Elektra is a Mexican retail and financial services group based in Mexico City, part of Grupo Salinas, controlled by Ricardo Salinas Pliego. It sells furniture, electronics and appliances on credit through Elektra and Salinas y Rocha stores, and runs Banco Azteca, a mass-market bank with branches inside stores, plus remittances and Italika motorcycles. It operates across Mexico and Latin America with thousands of stores and is listed on the Mexican exchange. Very strong consumer awareness, with a record of sports sponsorship in Mexico.

Wealthfront is a Palo Alto, California robo-advisor and financial app offering automated investing, high-yield cash accounts, bond ladders, stock portfolio tools and borrowing to millions of mostly young US customers. Founded in 2008, it manages tens of billions of dollars and raised about 274 million dollars. UBS had agreed to buy it in 2022 but canceled the deal, and it filed for a Nasdaq IPO in late 2025 (WLTH). Well-known fintech consumer brand in the US.

wiki.title: Wealthfront
wiki.text: Wealthfront Corporation is an American financial services company based in Palo Alto, California, founded by Andy Rachleff and Dan Carroll in 2008. As of September 2026, Wealthfront reported approximately $100 billion assets under management for more than 1.5 million clients.

about: TheStreet is a New York-based financial news and information company, founded in 1996 by Jim Cramer. It publishes market news, stock analysis, investing advice and personal-finance content via TheStreet.com and sells premium subscriptions and ad-supported content. It was listed on Nasdaq (TST) until it was acquired by TheMaven (now Arena Group) in 2019, and it later sold its Ratings business and was further divested. Known name among US retail investors.

wiki.title: TheStreet
wiki.what: US financial news and financial literacy website
wiki.text: TheStreet is a financial news and financial literacy website. It is a subsidiary of The Arena Group. The company provides both free content and subscription services such as TheStreet Pro, a stock recommendation portfolio managed by Chris Versace. TheStreet was founded by Marty Peretz and Jim Cramer, and the site boasted numerous notable former contributors, including Aaron Task, Herb Greenberg, and Brett Arends.

about: Billtrust is a US software company, based in Lawrenceville, New Jersey (listed in Nashville, Tennessee), that supplies accounts receivable automation, invoicing and payments software to B2B companies. It listed on Nasdaq via SPAC in 2021 (BTRS) and was taken private by EQT in early 2022 for around $1.7 billion. Customers include thousands of mid-market and enterprise suppliers. B2B fintech brand with no consumer visibility.

CI Financial is a Toronto-based wealth and asset management company offering mutual funds, advisory and wealth services in Canada, the US and Australia through CI Global Asset Management, Corient and others, with hundreds of billions of dollars under management and administration. Customers are retail investors and advisors, with revenue from management fees. Taken private in 2025 by a Mubadala Capital-led investor group, previously listed on the TSX (CIX). Known among Canadian investors.

wiki.title: CI Financial
wiki.text: CI Financial is a Canadian investment management company based in Toronto, Ontario. It offers investment management and wealth management services targeted to high net worth retail investors, as well as brokerage and trading services to portfolio managers and institutional investors.

about: Decentralized finance company behind the 1inch Network, a suite of crypto products including a DEX aggregator that finds the best prices across exchanges, a liquidity protocol, a wallet, and a limit order and cross-chain swap system. Launched in 2019 by Sergej Kunz and Anton Bukov, it is incorporated in Saint Kitts and Nevis and run through a distributed team, and has its own 1INCH token. Revenue comes from swap fees. Customers are crypto traders. High awareness in the crypto community, and a sponsor in blockchain and sporting events.

Indian Oil Corporation is India's flagship state-owned oil company, based in New Delhi, with refining (about 80 million tonnes a year), pipelines, marketing and the largest retail fuel network in India with over 38,000 fuel stations under IndianOil, XtraPremium and Servo lubricants. Revenue is more than 8 trillion rupees. Majority owned by the government of India, listed on NSE and BSE (IOC). Very high consumer awareness in India and a big sponsor in cricket and motorsport.

wiki.title: Indian Oil Corporation
wiki.what: Indian multinational oil and gas company
wiki.text: Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL), is an Indian multinational oil and gas company under the ownership of the Government of India and administrative control of the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas. It is a public sector undertaking which is registered in Mumbai and headquartered in New Delhi. It is the largest government-owned oil producer in the country both in terms of capacity and revenue. It has consolidated refining capacity of 80.55MMTPA.

Customers are refiners, utilities, shipping firms and national oil companies, and it earns from trading margins and logistics services. It is privately held and a large commodities trader by volume. B2B, little public brand awareness.

about: Bapco Energies is the Bahrain state-owned oil and gas holding company, the successor to Bapco, running the Sitra refinery, fuel distribution and retail through Bapco Energies Retail stations, Bahrain Petroleum, Tatweer Petroleum and Bapco Gas. It operates under the Bahrain government, with the Sitra refinery expansion project financed by about $4 billion of loans. It is a major national employer. Well-known in Bahrain.

Castleton Commodities International (CCI) is a Stamford, Connecticut commodities merchant trading and producing physical oil, gas, power and refined products, and owning upstream oil and gas assets through Castleton Resources and storage. Launched in 2011 with Carlyle backing. Customers are producers, utilities and industrial buyers. Private. B2B trader with little public brand awareness.

ESENTIA Energy Systems is a Mexican private natural gas infrastructure company operating pipelines that transport gas to power plants and industry in Mexico, based in Mexico City. Customers are the state electricity utility CFE and industrial buyers on long-term capacity contracts. Crunchbase shows about $2.3 billion in funding, largely financing. Private. B2B infrastructure brand with no consumer awareness.

about: Vienna-based integrated oil, gas and chemicals group, owner of Borealis and Borouge, with fuel stations in Central Europe. Majority-owned by Austrian ÖBAG and ADNOC. Listed in Vienna. Consumer-facing in Austria. Operates refineries and about 2,000 filling stations under OMV and Avanti brands in Central and Eastern Europe. Revenue about EUR 40 billion; high consumer visibility in Austria and neighbouring countries.

wiki.title: OMV
wiki.text: OMV, formerly an abbreviation for Österreichische Mineralölverwaltung Aktiengesellschaft (ÖMV), is the major integrated oil- and gas company in Austria with business activities, including fuels & feedstock, petrochemicals, and energy.
